newsitem.title: DUBAI: United Arab Emirates shares end quiet week stable.
newsitem.headline: United Arab Emirates shares end quiet week stable.

text.p: Shares on the informal United Arab Emirates market ended the week to Thursday mostly steady in quiet trade, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) index ended the week up a little at 2,450.21 from 2,447.86. Market leader Etisalat was steady at 955 dirhams for the third week running.
The biggest gainer was al-Khazna Insurance which shot up 55 dirhams to 335. Emirates Insurance Company added five dirhams to 610 dirhams and Abu Dhabi National Bank was up three at 425.
Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank remained at 300 dirhams. Similarly, Abu Dhabi National Insurance Co was unchanged at 1,015.
For the third week running Dubai Islamic Bank was weaker, falling to 174 dirhams from 175.
